wallpaper_folder_doc: The path to the currently selected wallpaper folder. Note: The path cannot have a trailing forward slash.
saved_wallpapers_doc: The collection of the currently saved wallpapers with their corresponding monitor, path and changer.

monitor_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the monitor dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected monitor. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
sort_by_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected sorting option. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
invert_sort_doc: The boolean flag to invert the currently selected sort-by option in the sort dropdown used by dconf.
changer_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected changer. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
image_filter_doc: The search string for the wallpapers.
swaybg_mode_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected swaybg mode. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
swaybg_color_doc: The hex color for swaybg background fill. Must be six characters long.
mpvpaper_pause_option_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected mpvpaper pause option. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
mpvpaper_slideshow_enable_doc: The boolean flag to enable/disable slideshows for mpvpaper used by dconf.
mpvpaper_slideshow_interval_doc: The number of seconds of that mpvpaper takes between switching images in slideshow mode. Note: The option must be a positive floating point number.
mpvpaper_additional_options_doc: Custom options for mpvpaper passed as command line arguments.
selected_monitor_item_doc: The currently selected monitor as a string. Note: The name must coincide with the monitor numeric identifier.
awww_resize_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected awww resize option. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
awww_fill_color_doc: The hex color for awww background fill. Must be six characters long.
awww_scaling_filter_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected awww scaling filter option. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
awww_transition_type_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected awww transition type option. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
awww_transition_step_doc: How fast the transition approaches the new image used by awww.
awww_transition_duration_doc: How long the transition takes to complete in seconds used by awww.
awww_transition_angle_doc: Used for the 'wipe' and 'wave' transitions used by awww. It controls the angle of the wipe.
awww_transition_position_doc: This is only used for the 'grow','outer' transitions used by awww. It controls the center of circle.
awww_invert_y_doc: Inverts the y position sent in 'transition_pos' flag used by awww.
awww_transition_wave_width_doc: Currently only used for 'wave' transition to control the width of each wave used by awww.
awww_transition_wave_height_doc: Currently only used for 'wave' transition to control the height of each wave used by awww.
awww_transition_bezier_p0_doc: Point 0 for the Bezier curve to use for the transition
awww_transition_bezier_p1_doc: Point 1 for the Bezier curve to use for the transition
awww_transition_bezier_p2_doc: Point 2 for the Bezier curve to use for the transition
awww_transition_bezier_p3_doc: Point 3 for the Bezier curve to use for the transition
awww_transition_fps_doc: Frame rate for the transition effect used by awww.
gslapper_scale_mode_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected gslapper scale mode. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
gslapper_pause_mode_doc: The internal numeric identifier in the changer dropdown used by dconf for the currently selected gslapper pause mode. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
gslapper_loop_doc: The boolean flag to loop video wallpapers in gslapper used by dconf.
gslapper_additional_options_doc: Custom options for gslapper passed as command line arguments.
